gahd: "Gahd, he are black in troot," Ella, mulatto Ella observed to herself; then aloud, "bettah giv' me a gill o' bakin' soda, I might wan' to make a cake."
"Oh, me Gahd," she had wept, "Oh, me Gahd, dem ah send me to de dawgs--dem ah send me to de dawgs.
All of a sudden a problem arose, "Gahd, I ain't got a bit o' salt in de house.
"Gahd, wha' she did got it, he?" folk asked; but neither London, nor Paris, nor Vienna answered.
